patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a max-width container, with full-width sections used for subtle background variations or the sticky navigation.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with very large, bold, dark headings contrasting with smaller, lighter-weight body text and uppercase navigation links.
The design relies on a predominantly white and light gray background palette, with a vibrant blue used consistently for calls-to-action, links, and subtle accents.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Feature sections often alternate between image-left/text-right and text-left/image-right layouts, creating a balanced and dynamic flow down the page.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed-position header that maintains its visibility and position at the top of the viewport during scroll.

Utilize CSS keyframe animations, likely triggered by JavaScript (e.g., Intersection Observer), to subtly reveal content sections and their internal elements (images, text blocks) with a gentle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the user's view.
Employ a responsive grid system and media queries to ensure content blocks, particularly image and text pairings, adapt gracefully across various screen sizes while maintaining visual balance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, dark headings (~2-3x body) with a clean, readable body text; subheadings are slightly larger than body but not as dominant as main headings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and app store badges, as well as image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content elements, particularly in the hero section.

standout: The site's design stands out through its sophisticated, almost editorial presentation of a digital product. It effectively uses high-quality, realistic app mockups integrated into a clean layout, making the journaling app feel tangible and aspirational rather than purely utilitarian.
